# Upstream provenance

This directory vendors `Orolia2s/disciplining-minipod` version 3.6.0 at commit
`2b17a3b7d2a945b2e7b8dc7dfa913bc9c9c3d25e`. It is the LGPL-2.1-or-later
algorithm dependency used by oscillatord. The small `_WIN32` compatibility
guards retain the same algorithm while allowing the Windows DLL wrapper to be
built with clang-cl.

Upstream: <https://github.com/Orolia2s/disciplining-minipod>
